title: Channel safe-mode response (PRF-02, catalogue module #12)
description: The creator-facing read and write response for safe mode: a per-channel moderation state the creator turns on and off (owner decision, 2026-09-16). While it is on, newly created alert deliveries for the channel are written held rather than ready, for the creator or a moderator to review. THE WHOLE STATE IS ONE BOOLEAN, DELIBERATELY: safe mode is never automatic -- no spike detection, no rejection-rate heuristic, no signal of any kind engages it -- so this contract carries no threshold, window, rate, duration, expiry, reason or trigger field, and additionalProperties false is what keeps it that way. It is also NOT alert_queues.is_paused, which is a queue lifecycle state this contract never exposes. Turning safe mode off releases nothing: deliveries already held stay held and are reviewed individually through the existing moderation path.
